description: The ONE principled evaluation of the FULL McPhail-Snyder–Reshetikhin lifted dilogarithm L(ζ⁰,ζ¹) (2509.02354 eq A.15, the flattened-tetrahedron complex Chern-Simons invariant) on the pinned trefoil eigenspace shape z=−h² — fixing the prior frontier probe's Li₂-only omission. RESULT: Re L = ¼ ln(1+h²) exactly (verified 30 dps + symbolic; Re ζ⁰=½ reconciles the corpus's z=½ and −h² frames); normalised g₂ = ln(1+h²)/h² ≈ 0.9788 ⇒ r ≈ −2.12%, WRONG SIGN and ~2.4× vs the measured +0.87% — the correct amplitude is FURTHER from target than the bare Li₂ (−1.07%). REFUTES the eigenspace-shape lifted-dilog route (scope-(a), not (b)). STRUCTURAL (Lean-proved): at the standard pinch all four MSR shape-logs = 0, so the octahedral e₂ = 0 — the four-shape octahedron degenerates at the pinched trefoil; the −h² is the eigenspace cross-ratio, not an MSR shape. Sharpened wall: the genuine regular part (D(ζ) torsion) is a root-of-unity object; closing r needs the fibre→archimedean τ transfer. scope-(a), audit-only, nothing wired; no scan (§2e).
tier: one principled full-amplitude evaluation (exact closed form) + Lean-proved structural degeneracy + sharpened wall; no fit, no scan

R1_full_lifted_dilog_closed_form.amplitude: MSR eq (A.15) L(ζ⁰,ζ¹) = Li₂(z)/(2πi) + πi ζ⁰ζ¹ + ζ⁰ log(1−z), flattening (A.8)
R1_full_lifted_dilog_closed_form.note_frames: Re ζ⁰ = ½ EXACTLY — reconciles the corpus's two trefoil frames (z=½ and −h²)

R2_refutation_scope_a.verdict: WRONG SIGN and ~2.4× magnitude (got −2.12%, target +0.87%). The full lifted dilog (correct amplitude) is FURTHER from target than the bare Li₂ (−1.07%). The eigenspace-shape lifted-dilog route, ALONE, does not reproduce r.
R2_refutation_scope_a.scope: (a) scope-limited negative — constrains magnitudes/combinations, NOT ingredients. No proved invariant excludes the lifted dilog from a closure; this is not (b).
R2_refutation_scope_a.no_scan: one principled evaluation; dilog forms/shapes NOT scanned to hit +0.87% (§2e).

R3_pinch_degeneracy.meaning: deuteron σ₁³ = trefoil (torus knot) ⇒ crossings PINCHED (§5.2 Def 5.3); at the standard pinch (eq 5.7) all four MSR shape-logs = 0, so the octahedral e₂ = 0. The 'four-shape octahedron' has NO four-distinct-shape content at the pinched trefoil; g₂ is NOT the naive octahedral e₂ of the ζ⁰_j. The −h² is the eigenspace cross-ratio, a different invariant.

sharpened_wall.torsion_factor: the genuine MSR regular part (Garoufalidis-Kashaev A.17) carries D(ζ)=∏_{k=1}^{N-1}(1−ω^{ζ+k})^{k/N}, a q=root-of-unity (N→∞) object
sharpened_wall.regime_gap: D(ζ) lives in the FIBRE (root of unity); g₂ is at the real substrate q₀ (ARCHIMEDEAN). Closing r needs the fibre→archimedean (τ) transfer of the pinched regular part — NOT a further real-q₀ evaluation.
sharpened_wall.scope: scope-(a): sharpens the frontier (#4347) from 'compute the 4-shape octahedron' to 'the 4-shape object degenerates at the pinch; the real object is the pinched regular part in the root-of-unity regime, needing the τ transfer'.
